## Construction

- `old.bin`: 1024 bytes — `[i & 0xFF for i in range(1024)]` (bytes 0..255 repeated 4×)
- `new.bin`: same as old, but bytes 200–215 replaced with `0xAA×16`, and 32 bytes of `0x55` appended
- `golden.inplace`: raw HPatchLite inplace-A patch produced by `hdiffi.exe -inplace old.bin new.bin golden.inplace`

Later tasks use these vectors to verify byte-exact round-trip of the pure-Dart applier.
